passages.note: House Third Reading roll call shows Payne voting Y on HB2853.

passages.provision_quote: Notwithstanding section 15-2401, beginning in the 2022-2023 school year, in this chapter, unless the context otherwise requires, "qualified student" includes a resident of this state who both: 1. Is eligible to enroll in a public school in this state in any of the following: ( a ) A preschool program for children with disabilities. ( b ) A kindergarten program. ( c ) Any of grades one through twelve. 2. Does not otherwise qualify for an Arizona empowerment scholarship account pursuant to this chapter.
passages.note: Chaptered bill text adds section 15-2401.01, extending ESA eligibility to any resident eligible to enroll in public school.
Bill History page lists Payne as a co-sponsor of HB2853.

rows.reasoning: Kevin Payne co-sponsored HB2853 (2022) and voted Y on its House Third Reading; the chaptered bill added section 15-2401.01 making any "resident of this state" who is merely "eligible to enroll in a public school" (preschool for disabilities, kindergarten, or grades one through twelve) a qualified empowerment-scholarship-account student, removing the prior targeted-eligibility limits. This matches the rung "Providing universal vouchers so that education funding follows the student to any school — public, private, or religious — chosen by the family," since it extends ESA eligibility to essentially all Arizona K-12 students rather than an income-capped or otherwise targeted subset.
